name: Eocursor
sum: A lightly built, bipedal Early Jurassic ornithischian of about 1 m from South Africa, one of the most completely known early members of the group.
wsnote: Estimated length of about 1 m (English Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: SAM-PK-K8025, partial skeleton collected in 1993 from the Upper Elliot Formation, Free State, South Africa.
material: Partial skeletal elements including skull fragments, vertebrae, pelvis, long leg bones and unusually large grasping hands.
biology: A lightly built biped; its triangular, iguana-like teeth suggest partial herbivory.
author: Butler et al. 2007

images.artist: D. B. Norman, M. G. Baron, M. S. Garcia & R. T. Müller
images.caption: Skeletal reconstruction of Eocursor parvus

sources.text: R. J. Butler, R. M. H. Smith, and D. B. Norman. 2007. A primitive ornithischian dinosaur from the Late Triassic of South Africa, and the early evolution and diversification of Ornithischia. Proceedings of the Royal Society of London B 274:2041-2046

dates_note: Originally given as Late Triassic (Norian); later work found no independent dating, so an Early Jurassic age cannot be excluded.
